_why: BOX C — the auth box: the self-hosted GoTrue and its Postgres since 2026-09-24 (Box A before). Declared as DATA and read back by tooling/ops/check-box-declared.mjs, READ-ONLY over SSH: exit 1 on drift, 2 when it could not look.

This is the box the product cannot survive losing (tooling/ops/register.json `_substrateHosts._supabaseBoxCronWhy`): every identity's foreign key lives in its database. Its five root crons are the five `duty.supabase-*` rows, carried from Box A byte-identical on 2026-09-24.

No address is written here; the box is reached through the environment names under `ssh`. A field the public tree does not state is null and is reported UNREAD (LOST) until the first read-back fills it.

cost.why: Cited by vendor id, never copied: CI cannot read Private, so box-move grades the cost delta LOST there.

spec.verify: check-box-declared.mjs reads nproc, free -b and df -B1 / and compares (RAM and disk within 15% below the plan's figure)

cronTz.carried: measured on Box A, whose crontab moved to this box byte-identical on 2026-09-24; the read-back re-reads it here (trap shell-25: cron reads the timezone once at start, so record it as read, never as assumed)

volumes.name: /opt/supabase
volumes.holds: the compose project, its .env (JWT_SECRET is read from it by the dump) and the dumps (backups/)

volumes.name: db-config
volumes.holds: the pgsodium root key the dump copies out (duty.supabase-dump)

hostnames.name: auth-api.nikatru.com
hostnames.via: the Box C Cloudflare tunnel, through envoy

hostnames.name: studio.nikatru.com
hostnames.via: the Box C Cloudflare tunnel, behind Cloudflare Access

tunnel.why: auth-api is served through the tunnel and envoy (services/edge-shield sits in front of /auth/v1/*): the record does not change in a move; the connector runs on the target with this secret.

allowLists.where: the Postgres pg_hba.conf in the supabase db volume: the host lines that admit a client by address
allowLists.verify: on the box, read pg_hba.conf through the db container (SHOW hba_file; then read the file) and list the address lines, names only

allowLists.where: the Cloudflare WAF and rate-limit rules in front of auth-api (services/edge-shield, row O-BOXES-UNSHIELDED-FROM-SPIKES) that name the origin's address
allowLists.verify: list the zone's custom rules and grep their expressions for the declared address
